recipes.title: Double Pistachio Crunch Protein Creami

items.i: sugar-free pistachio Jell-O pudding mix (~12 g)

steps: Blend the base until smooth (immersion blender or frother), adding the dry ingredients slowly while mixing, then keep blending 90 seconds.
Pour into a Creami pint, lid on, and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours.
Run the pint under hot water for 1 minute, then spin on Lite Ice Cream. Re-spin if it's crumbly.
Make a hole down the middle with a spoon or knife, add the mix-ins and run the Mix-in cycle.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per pint.
